projects.title: Linear Feedback Register And Unit Testing
projects.description:
o Developed Linear Feedback Register class and represent shift register as a C++ string.
o Implemented left shifting by feeding string into an ostringstream object and appending the result of tap position XOR with left most bit.
o Used Boost test framework to test program against edge cases, and typical cases.

projects.title: Sierpinski Triangle
projects.description:
o Implemented Sierpinski Triangle in C++ using recursion.
o Developed tree data structure to draw triangles recursively based on recursive depth.
o Used Simple and Fast Multimedia Library to draw colorful triangle pattern.
